title: Coffee for Marcelle

nodes.speaker: Marcelle DeNuite
nodes.text: Well, if it isn't my old friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, if it isn't my old friend.

nodes.speaker: Marcelle DeNuite
nodes.text: And so it was. Did you expect me to lie to my readers? Head Tomatoes is a respected column.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And so it was. Did you expect me to lie to my readers? Head Tomatoes is a respected column.

nodes.speaker: Marcelle DeNuite
nodes.text: You earned it. All I want is to share such genuine feeling with the world.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You earned it. All I want is to share such genuine feeling with the world.

nodes.speaker: Marcelle DeNuite
nodes.text: No, you have enough Lims to bribe your way to success I’m sure. What is it that you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, you have enough Lims to bribe your way to success I’m sure. What is it that you want?

nodes.speaker: Marcelle DeNuite
nodes.text: Indeed! My own invention. The warmth of the milk brings out the piquancy in the cheese, whilst the coolness of the ice refreshes the palate beautifully.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed! My own invention. The warmth of the milk brings out the piquancy in the cheese, whilst the coolness of the ice refreshes the palate beautifully.

nodes.speaker: Marcelle DeNuite
nodes.text: Oh, you can be assured I will.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, you can be assured I will.

nodes.speaker: Marcelle DeNuite
nodes.text: You do, hmm? Then what is it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You do, hmm? Then what is it?

nodes.speaker: Marcelle DeNuite
nodes.text: I wouldn't sully my palette with something so lurid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wouldn't sully my palette with something so lurid.
Intriguing, but no.

nodes.speaker: Marcelle DeNuite
nodes.text: Once again you show what little imagination you have. Good day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Once again you show what little imagination you have. Good day.

nodes.speaker: Marcelle DeNuite
nodes.text: Ough, far too harsh on the stomach!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ough, far too harsh on the stomach!
You called my restaurant mediocre!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thank you for the review. It helped business. I think.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you for the review. It helped business. I think.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Thank you for the review. It helped business. I think.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Thank you for the review. It helped business. I think.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I don’t need you.
I have your coffee order.
Well, enjoy...
The Tequila Corretto.
The Blue Cheese Pour Over.
The Mushroom Mocha.
The Black Ultra Grande Latte.
Sounds gross.
